artifact_rule.declared: before any N5 branch was run; characterization used for preference criterion 3 only
artifact_rule.metric: per-update group mean of A, epoch median
artifact_rule.name: N5_ARTIFACT_RETENTION_CHARACTERIZATION_V1
artifact_rule.reference_floor_source: frozen budget hinge ARTIFACT_MIN (A10 D10.6, methods/gpat/losses.py); same rule as N4
artifact_rule.retained: every complete stage-3 epoch of the branch window (epochs 16..25) has median group-mean A >= 0.01 and no declared collapse

S0.long_sampling: every 5th update from u16576, the first 30 updates, every AMP-retry update, u(ramp_end)-20..u(ramp_end)+20 for S1/S2 ends 17680 and 22100, the last 20 updates, and collapse onset-30..event+30; epoch summaries use every update

S1.long_sampling: every 5th update from u16576, the first 30 updates, every AMP-retry update, u(ramp_end)-20..u(ramp_end)+20 for S1/S2 ends 17680 and 22100, the last 20 updates, and collapse onset-30..event+30; epoch summaries use every update

S2.long_sampling: every 5th update from u16576, the first 30 updates, every AMP-retry update, u(ramp_end)-20..u(ramp_end)+20 for S1/S2 ends 17680 and 22100, the last 20 updates, and collapse onset-30..event+30; epoch summaries use every update

collapse_rule.declared: M7D1-N5 instruction section 6, implemented before any N5 branch was run; identical to N4_IDENTITY_COLLAPSE_V1
collapse_rule.event_update: the 10th update of that run (first update at which the 10-update condition holds)
collapse_rule.metric: M_mean: mean of M = sigmoid(float(mask_logit)) over every mask pixel of every sample of the accepted (COMPLETE) forward of update u (sample-weighted over the microbatches of the group)
collapse_rule.name: N5_IDENTITY_COLLAPSE_V1
collapse_rule.onset_update: first update of the first run of 10 consecutive updates with M_mean < 0.01

open_mask_note: open-mask saturation (M -> 1, sigmoid derivative -> 0) is characterized and reported; no pass/fail threshold is attached to it (instruction section 13)
preference: smallest deviation from the frozen curriculum
scientific_root_listing_command: cd <scientific run root> && find . -type f -printf "%P %s %T@\n" | sort | sha256sum (same command as N4; launcher writes results/scientific_root_{pre,post}.txt)
